weapon.d: Inflicts Spd-2. If unit initiates combat, unit attacks twice.

assist.d:
Grants another action to target ally.
(Cannot target an ally with Sing or Dance.)

a.d: If unit initiates combat, grants Spd+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+2 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk/Spd+4 during combat.
If unit initiates combat, grants Atk+6, Spd+7 during combat.

b.d: If unit’s HP ≤ 25% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.
If unit’s HP ≤ 50% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.
If unit’s HP ≤ 75% and unit initiates combat, unit can make a follow-up attack before foe can counterattack.

c.d: At start of turn, if unit's HP = 100%, grants the following status to adjacent flying allies for 1 turn: "Unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces."
At start of turn, if unit's HP ≥ 50%, grants the following status to adjacent flying allies for 1 turn: "Unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces."
At start of turn, grants the following status to adjacent flying allies for 1 turn: "Unit can move to a space adjacent to any ally within 2 spaces."
